nodes.title: How to use
nodes.text:
1. Set video_path to your .webm / .mp4 / .mkv.
2. Pick the subtitle source (embedded track or sidecar .srt/.vtt).
3. separation_model 'htdemucs_ft' (cleanest voice) or 'htdemucs' (faster) saves the clean-voice file <timestamp>_voice.flac plus the shared <timestamp>.txt per subtitle. Set it to 'off' for a single mixed <timestamp>.flac (or if demucs is not installed).
4. Queue - files land in ComfyUI/output/subtitle_audio_slices/<video name>.
5. segment_list shows one line per cut: <name>_voice.flac | start - end | text.

Separation needs `pip install demucs` in the ComfyUI python env. Background stems were removed in v1.4.0 (dub merges drift when a second stem is involved).
